record.excerpt: So basically I use 5EMA and also use a 50EMA ( for trend basically ) then I set my RSI to 5 also… … So once your 5ema crosses your 50ema and RSI cross the 50 line, boom there is your signal, … I do like to wait for the candle of that day to close though, … since this week I started using it on the daily and 4 hour charts … So far I have opened 4 trades at 8pm last night (20/08/2013) on USD/CAD, EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and also EUR/JPY.
record.performance_claim: usd/cad has moved just over 200 pips in my favour
record.notes: Forex EMA5/50 + RSI(5) cross 50 rule; no page date header, in-text date 20/08/2013 implies post ~2013-08-21.
